findings.title: The A4 floor FAIL (17/30) is an artifact of the as-of snapshot ingest shape, not a feed property; on the plan's own frozen V8 basis the ng2/ng3 census yields >= 50 era-in usable first-print events (A4 PASS) and the terminal BLOCKED_DATA close is unsupported
evidence: Plan sec 2 freezes the EZ basis as 'pinned vintaged EZ HICP (V8-measured FULL S0 coverage)' and sec 3 requires 'first-print vs revision streams per ng2/ng3 standards'. The committed V8 staged manifest (forex-free-v8_run/staged_vintaged_manifest.json, EZ entry sha 886f0afee88ac916a9aaeaabc57874ece6615b905c045b83a45551c3e72d5735) pins 696 binding rows, obs 1996-01-01..2025-06-01, retrieval window 2018-01-01..2025-08-01 with semantics 'rows = (obs_date, value) binding periods intersecting the window' -- i.e. rows carry TRUE vintage windows. Committed V8 evidence p0_earliest_vintage_v8.json: CP0000EZ19M086NEST earliest_vintage_upper_bound = 2015-02-27 (HTTP 200 at that as-of date), quoted by the cycle's own committed p0a census ('earliest vintage <= 2015-02-27').

Recompute on the detached tree (pinned bytes, value-identical census): the reconstructed panel contains EXACTLY 696 versions for obs 1996-01-01..2025-06-01 == V8's 696 binding rows. The re-ingest therefore recovered exactly the V8 version multiset (the mandated warmup month 2017-12 compensates the window edge); both V8 and the panel see the same versions.

The p0b ingest queries ALFRED as-of (realtime_start=realtime_end=vintage_day); the lane's own measured semantics (census reconstruction_law): every returned row's window is CLAMPED to the query day. The reconstructed panel's realtime_starts are therefore all 1st-of-month clamped days, so ng2's frozen era law (era_start = min realtime_start over rows, applied unmodified) collapses to 2017-12-01. On the V8 true-window rows the SAME law yields era_start <= 2015-02-27. The era_start -- and hence the first-print-era restriction -- is a function of the query shape, not the feed.

Consequence, measured from the recomputed panel: the obs 2015-03..2017-11 cohort (33 obs months) carries exactly 2 versions each -- the value in force at the panel start, changed at the 2019-04-01 re-publication (v2 clamped day 2019-04-01 for all 33, inside S0 2018-04-04..2025-04-30). On the V8 true-window basis these months are >= era_start (2015-03-01 >= 2015-02-27 bound), their v1->v2 gaps are genuine first-print revision events with v2 availability days in S0 (PIT-usable on the frozen grid), and their true v1 days are distinct per month so the bulk signature rule (>=10 identical (v1 day, v2 day, ratio) signatures) does not collapse them -- the same reason the panel measured 0 bulk groups. A4 >= 17 (measured restricted) + 33 (cohort) = 50 >= 30 => PASS; larger still if the true archive zero predates the 2015-02-27 upper bound.

Decision impact: p0_gate.json verdict BLOCKED_DATA rests solely on the EZ A4 FAIL (P0a substrate and EURUSD probe PASS; A5 16>=12 PASS; canaries 5/5). With A4 PASS on the plan-conformant basis the P0 gate is PASS, both lanes live, and the cycle belongs at D1 -- not closed FOREX_NG4_BLOCKED_DATA_OR_SELECTION.

The p0b handoff known_limitations assertion 'A4 floor FAIL is a measured property of the feed ... not an ingest defect' is thereby refuted for the pre-2018 cohort: the shortfall is a property of the mandated clamped as-of query shape (a dispatch/lane design choice), which no plan text freezes and which was never reconciled against the plan's frozen V8 basis. By the handoff's own law ('a floor change is an owner decision, never a lane one'), the effective re-scoping of the measurement basis (true-window archive => clamped snapshot panel) was not an authorized floor/standard change.
